title: 2027 Ontario Water & Wastewater Conference & Trade Show
organizationName: Ontario Water Works Association and Water Environment Association of Ontario
whatIsHappening: 2027 Ontario Water & Wastewater Conference & Trade Show is committed at Hotel X Toronto; Sheraton Centre Toronto; Hyatt Regency Toronto; Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle Hotel (May 10, 2027 – May 13, 2027). The principal housing is not available to Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown.
whyThisHotel: Conditional supplementary delegate/speaker/exhibitor or executive lodging; no published room volume or overflow requirement. Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown cannot realistically win the committed 2027 principal housing; Convention-scale event (~2000 attendees); realistic role for a 157-room Harbourfront hotel is delegate/speaker overflow, VIP lodging and side functions — not primary housing.
potentialHotelBusiness: Future-cycle account development and/or separately evidenced overflow only — not the committed principal housing.
whyActNow: Competitor commitment confirmed at Hotel X Toronto; Sheraton Centre Toronto; Hyatt Regency Toronto; Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle Hotel; develop the organizer relationship for a future cycle or residual overflow lodging.
recommendedNextStep: Contact the relevant housing representative to establish whether overflow accommodation or a secondary room block is needed for Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown. Competitor booking is confirmed at Hotel X Toronto; Sheraton Centre Toronto; Hyatt Regency Toronto; Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle Hotel — do not request an RFP as host.
uncertainties: Who has accommodation contracting authority across OWWA and WEAO, and whether a third-party housing agency is appointed. Live 2027 booking mechanism, rates, booking codes, cutoff dates, four-hotel allotments, pickup, peak rooms and room nights are unverified.
